q: Which Standard Liège goalkeeper headed a 95th minute equaliser against AZ Alkmaar in the 2009 Champions League?
sub: The first keeper to score from open play in the competition.

q: Which Belgian club forfeited three games in a row in December 2009, went under, and had every result it had played wiped from the table?
sub: The players had not been paid since November.

q: Royal Antwerp took a steady stream of young loan players from which English club from 1998 onwards?
sub: John O'Shea and Jonny Evans were among the thirty-odd sent over.

q: Which Belgian club did Qatar's Aspire academy buy in 2012, as a way of getting its graduates into European football?
sub: Paris Saint-Germain's owners took the club on later.

q: UEFA threw the 2019 Belgian Cup winners out of the Europa League over match-fixing. Which club was it?
sub: They had been accused of buying a relegation game the year before.

q: Which club finished bottom when the 2019-20 Belgian season was abandoned, then stayed up because the league voted to grow to eighteen?
Which Belgian club went bankrupt in 2013, was rebuilt by taking over a local amateur side, and was back in the top flight by 2020?
sub: They restarted in the fifth tier in front of twelve thousand.

q: Which American investor, also behind Crystal Palace and Lyon, bought RWD Molenbeek and took them up in 2023?
sub: They went straight back down a year later.

q: Union Saint-Gilloise could not host a European home game at their own ground. Whose stadium across Brussels did they borrow?
sub: The Stade Joseph Marien does not meet UEFA's rules.

q: Belgium's top flight has carried the name Jupiler since 1993. What sort of thing is Jupiler?
sub: A pilsner brewed at Jupille, near Liege.

q: Standard Liège were 3-1 up in October 2022 when the game was abandoned. Whose fans had thrown flares and seats onto the pitch?
sub: The same fixture had been called off the same way in 2019.

q: Which Belgian club led Real Madrid 2-0 at half time at the Bernabeu in 2019, both goals from Emmanuel Dennis?
sub: Ramos and Casemiro rescued a 2-2 draw.
